name: smwpatches-super-mario-maker-keys-pink-coin
title: Super Mario Maker - Keys & Pink Coin
description:
This pack installs some ASM hacks to allow Mario to have keys following him, as well a pink coin that gives Mario a key.

Be sure to read the included readme!

Video in action: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yyuuZYVF5n4
